mcq_drop.why: opinion item ('criticised as eroding'), vague statement 4

patterns: PYQs here are conceptual one-liners: 'constitutional government' = limited government; best safeguard of liberty = separation of powers.
Expect direct definition items with abstract distractors (popular / multi-party / committed judiciary); no article-number drills in the PYQs.
App goes much deeper: Union-State article pairs (85-174, 123-213, 111-200), case-law statements and amendment-override matches - sound but above PYQ depth.
Common traps worth keeping: 175 vs 174 for Governor's summoning; Minerva Mills (not Golaknath) for the 42nd Amendment review bar; Art. 143 advice not binding.
